description: Mantine lead with Diggersby as the flexible safe swap and the new Icy Wind Thievul as the primary closer. Roles can flip — you can open Diggersby against fliers/steels and keep Mantine in the back. Diggersby runs Quick Attack over the standard Mud Shot for faster fast-move pressure.
performanceNotes: Creator went 'quite positive' with the team and calls it the best/most recommended build for Icy Wind Thievul
Mantine is praised as a top-tier lead thanks to strong typing in the current meta
Diggersby is a bulky Fighting/Ground pivot that hard-answers Lickilicky and sponges hits with Scorching Sands + Fire Punch

sources.author: JonkusPKMN
sources.videoTitle: STEALING the Show?! *NEW* Icy Wind THIEVUL keeps CLIMBING in the Great League
